Subject: RE: Intermittent stalls during large checkouts (streaming)

Summary of what I see after ingesting the attached trace and server traces:
- Root cause (prelim): our streaming parser's frame-synchronization path miscounts frame boundaries when client chunked headers contain trailing whitespace or an extra CRLF on the header block. This causes the downstream assembly to drop the next header chunk and re-run the parser, which manifests as silent stalls and retry storms.
- Triage notes: reproduces locally against checkout-sdk v1.4.2 (older chunking logic). Not reproducible against the patched v1.5.0 client.
- Impact: affects flows that send many small chunks (mobile web + older native), increases CPU due to re-parses and raises p99.

Proposed short-term mitigations:
1) Server side: enable tolerant-frame-parse=true on the gateway for FastCart (config toggle) — low risk, immediate (minutes).
2) Client side: fast patch to checkout-sdk to strip trailing header CRLFs and normalize chunk boundaries (v1.5.1 candidate) — deployable in a day for standard CI flows; mobile rollout will take longer.
3) Monitoring: create a metric for parser-resync events and an alert at >0.5% of sessions.

I attached a minimal reproducer and a parsed sample (logs.zip). I'll open SUP-12842 and link traces.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
